steps.title: Asking forgiveness
steps.meaning: I ask Allah for forgiveness. Say it three times.

ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 591 (sunnah.com/muslim:591)

steps.title: You are Peace
steps.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
steps.meaning: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of Glory and Honour.

ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 591 (sunnah.com/muslim:591)
ruling.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
ruling.english: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished his prayer he asked forgiveness three times and said: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace; blessed are You, Possessor of Glory and Honour.

steps.title: Tasbih, 33 times
steps.meaning: Glory be to Allah. Say it 33 times.

ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 595a (sunnah.com/muslim:595a)
ruling.english: Say “Glory be to Allah” thirty-three times.

steps.title: Tahmid, 33 times
steps.meaning: All praise is for Allah. Say it 33 times.

ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 595a (sunnah.com/muslim:595a)
ruling.english: Say “All praise is for Allah” thirty-three times.

steps.title: Takbir, 33 times
steps.meaning: Allah is the greatest. Say it 33 times.

ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 595a (sunnah.com/muslim:595a)
ruling.english: Say “Allah is the greatest” thirty-three times.
